ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into child care fraud in Minnesota, including the role of funding freezes and program terminations
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How have funding freezes affected child care programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the impact of funding freezes on vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Freezes on Sanctuary Cities
ideas.description: Investigation into the impact of federal funding freezes on sanctuary cities, including the effects on child care and healthcare programs
questions: What is the scope of federal funding freezes on sanctuary cities?
How have funding freezes affected child care and healthcare programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the consequences of funding freezes on vulnerable populations and the role of politics in funding decisions.
